title: A living bridge
summary: Let Cordweaver links carry 0.5 carbon in game units. A broken link, or anything added to the dish (food, life or a tool input), ends this attempt.
completedText: Cordweaver links carried 0.5 carbon in this attempt by {time}.
endedText: A link broke or something was added to the dish, so this attempt ended at {time}. The dish keeps going.
